title: Temasek Unit, Nexus Ink Deal to Acquire Stakes in Post Advisory

title: Bank of Korea Holds Rates Amid Concerns Over Housing, Lending
content: The Bank of Korea kept its policy rate unchanged, holding off on resuming an easing cycle until it sees clearer signs that financial imbalances from housing, lending and currency markets are stabilizing.

title: Blackstone Seeks to Amend, Extend $957 Million Interplex Loan
content: Blackstone is in talks with banks to amend and extend its $957 million loan that had backed its acquisition of Singaporean precision engineering firm Interplex Holdings Pte., according to people familiar with the matter.

title: RBC’s Record Quarter for Capital Markets Fuels Earnings Beat
content: Royal Bank of Canada topped estimates on strong performance across its biggest businesses and as the firm set aside less money than expected to cover possible loan losses, a rebound from notable misses on credit earlier this year. The company’s shares surged.
